concerns.text: T021A says 'If a quantization level is missing from a split, PROCEED with available levels, log a warning' — this silently relaxes FR-004's MUST for joint training across INT4/INT8/FP8 and contradicts plan.md Complexity Tracking ('random splitting risks omitting a quantization level, violating the joint requirement'). T015's FAIL-LOUDLY guard (FR-004) is undermined downstream.

US-001 Scenario 3 requires a statistical significance test (p < 0.05) comparing mean divergence INT8/INT4/FP8 vs FP16. T016 only 'records the actual observed proportion of non-zero calculated_kl_divergence samples' — the acceptance criterion is dropped; no task performs this test.

No task produces a metrics.json conforming to the metrics contract (correlation_results per level with bound_consistency boolean at >95% threshold, latency_reduction in ms, collinearity_check). T030 writes seconds, T027B writes a differently-shaped file, and T024's contract test has no producer artifact to validate — the contract is effectively abandoned.

SC-002 targets ≥90% reduction in the *policy evaluation step*, but T030 reads total_time (defaulting to 0 with a warning if missing) vs a baseline of 'sum of all sync times' — measuring a different quantity than the success criterion, and the default-0 fallback can spuriously satisfy the ≥90% check.

requirements.txt omits scipy (needed for T027 paired t-test/Shapiro-Wilk/Bonferroni, T038 chi-square, T018/T019d VIF) and onnxruntime (plan-listed fallback engine for FR-002). Constitution Principle I requires every dependency pinned; tasks depending on unstated packages are not reproducible in the isolated venv.

FR-007 requires verifying the bound 'holds consistently'; the metrics contract defines bound_consistency as >95% of samples satisfying |predicted-actual|<0.1. T027B only computes satisfaction percentages and an aggregate metric without any pass/fail threshold, so no task actually verifies FR-007's success condition.

T026A injects short-answer GSM8K samples (answer_token_length ≤ 5, ≥5% of n=300) into the synchronized input set. No FR, SC, or spec edge case authorizes modifying the evaluation dataset; trace this to a requirement or document it as an explicit plan-level decision.
